title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Exclusions: Force-Placed Premiums Net of Refunds
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, Premier 150 exclusion schedule: the placed-premium part.** For the Premier excluded total, the force-placed premiums enter as the placed-premium part. That part is net of refunds credited or, where the proof's coverage starts inside the latest billing period, net of the refund due. The premiums, refunds and proofs are those on the contract's Collateral Protection Insurance tracking record.

**The part follows how the placement ended.**

1. When refunds of those premiums were credited back to the contract balance, the part is the premiums added less the refunds credited.
2. When no refund has been credited, the latest accepted proof of insurance was reviewed on or after the billing date of the latest premium added, and its policy effective date falls within that premium's billing period, the part is the premiums added less that latest premium's share for the days of its billing period from the proof's policy effective date on. The share is the premium times those days divided by the days of its billing period, both counted inclusive, rounded half-up to the cent. That share is the whole refund the collateral protection terms leave due when the proof's coverage starts inside the latest billing period.
3. Otherwise, including a proof whose coverage starts before the latest billing period while its refund is not yet credited, the premiums added enter without any reduction.

**Definitions.**

- *Latest premium added:* the force-placed premium whose billing period starts latest, whatever its billing date. A backdated placement bills two or more premiums on one day, while no two premiums share a billing period.
- *Latest accepted proof:* the proof the tracking record shows as accepted with the latest review date. Where two accepted proofs were reviewed on that date, the one recorded first counts.

| Placement ending shown on the tracking record | Placed-premium part |
|---|---|
| refunds credited to the contract balance | premiums added less refunds credited |
| no refund credited, accepted proof reviewed after the last billing, coverage starting inside the last billing period | premiums added less the last premium's share from the coverage start |
| no refund credited, coverage starting before the last billing period | premiums added, unreduced |
| no accepted proof | premiums added, unreduced |
